What’s new in DriveDeck 0.20.4

• Added Plaid Track beside Model S, with a visual display picker for Temp, Clean, We’ve gone plaid! and Plaid Sensors.
• Clean includes a detailed monochrome drivetrain viewed from the front, a smaller illustration, component-temperature bars, engine temperature and tire pressures.
• Plaid’s moving tunnel, glowing rays and portal frames span the entire gauge. The launch displays include a preparation state before the first movement.
• Added live front/rear brake surface temperatures through the bundled companion. Motor temperatures stay blank where unavailable.
• Lowered Civetta’s display selector so the fullscreen menu no longer covers it.
• Replaced the Hopper and Ardente vehicle images and updated their crop settings.

Reinstall the bundled companion and fully restart BeamNG to enable brake temperature readings. Existing settings are preserved.
